rv.q: Directors Lucy Moss and Jamie Armitage have taken what appears on the surface to be a simple production — one set, six cast members, a small band — and made it a visually and aurally exciting experience.
The entertainment value of “Six” is unimpeachable and the research that went into it seems pretty solid.
You will see a highly entertaining, energetic show with a relevant message that each of these women was more individually than just one of six.
But for me, the third time was simply not the charm with this overly slick production.

cn.t: Critics praise SIX as an entertaining pop musical that cleverly transforms the stories of Henry VIII's six wives into an energetic history lesson, with reviewers celebrating its sharp lyrics and engaging theatrical alchemy.
